scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Love Means Checking
cards.instruction: Treat close monitoring of choices, moods, and details as care, becoming more involved whenever you feel uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Text me when you arrive, then when you've found your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Text me when you've started doing that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Text when you and Ben reach the cinema, love, so I know you're safe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum, my phone stays off during the film.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When does it finish? I'll wait up for your message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're walking to dinner afterwards. We haven't chosen anywhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive behind you while you choose. You can keep your phone off; I'll see for myself that you're having a nice time.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands detailed updates and A5 absorbs independence into another check, though care and uncertainty are conveyed implicitly.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 turns B2's cinema into a dark-room rationale; A5 turns B4's self-care assurance into a reporting requirement.

relationship.evidence: B2 minimizes the outing's risk and B4 asserts autonomy, each forcing A to justify continued involvement.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4's ability to look after themself another event requiring notification.

specificity.evidence: A1 specifies arrival and seat updates; B2 grounds them in an ordinary cinema visit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's apparent agreement immediately becomes another check, precisely using B4's wording and claim.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 frames arrival monitoring as safety; A3 seeks a replacement check-in; A5 responds to uncertain dinner plans with physical surveillance framed sincerely as ensuring a nice time.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's phone restriction leads directly to A3 asking when the film ends. B4's unchosen dinner destination makes that endpoint insufficient, causing A5 to propose following while they choose.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies A as Mum and establishes a reasonable phone boundary. B4 introduces spontaneous plans with Ben, changing what A can monitor without making B merely a joke feeder.

heightening.evidence: After B4 removes certainty about the evening's destination, A5 escalates from A3's waiting for a message to driving behind the couple and directly inspecting their enjoyment.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a parent checking on a cinema outing with Ben; B2 supplies the phone-off constraint, and B4's walk to an undecided restaurant gives A5 a concrete, immediately playable intervention.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'You can keep your phone off' turns B2's boundary into justification for a more intrusive accommodation. The final explanation is slightly extended but remains within A's caring logic.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says the phone stays off during the film; A3 moves the requested contact to the film's finish and commits to waiting.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reveals that the evening continues on foot without a chosen destination; A5 proposes following by car to eliminate uncertainty while accommodating the phone restriction.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1's safety check develops through A3's schedule inquiry into A5's monitoring of choices and mood, with uncertainty increasing involvement.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 escalates the established caring surveillance from remote messages to physical presence without resolving the scene or requiring B to agree.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S88 makes A express care through monitoring and respond to uncertainty by increasing involvement.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic control demands obedience without needing uncertainty to expand a sincerely protective role.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 names safety as the reason for contact; B2's unavailable phone makes A3 wait up, and B4's undecided walking destination makes A5 volunteer to follow and observe their enjoyment.

records.recommendedEdit: Corrected the rejected candidate's routine allergy assistance by removing that new justification and developing monitoring itself. The illustrative mother and cinema outing with Ben remain; B4 now specifies walking while choosing dinner. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, because A1 equates contact with safety and A5 treats observing choices and enjoyment as helpful care; logic 5, because B2's unavailable phone causes A3's finish-time check, while B4's undecided walk causes A5's offer to follow during the choice; relationship 4, because B2 protects film etiquette and B4 wants an unplanned continuation with Ben, which A5 attempts to accommodate on intrusive terms; heightening 4, because uncertainty changes A's involvement from waiting for a message to personally observing the outing; specificity 4, because A1 names the cinema companion and B4 supplies a concrete activity, although the street layout is unspecified; brevity and wit 4, because A5 presents dispensing with messages as a kindness while replacing them with closer surveillance. Total 90. Five spoken ABABA turns, 67 words; internal hard gates pass. This is a separate model reread, not live testing.
records.remainingConcern: The leap to following by car is deliberately broad, and B4 states plans rather than actively negotiating the intrusion. Neither undermines the causal chain. No rewrite needed; retain the supplied dialogue.
records.writerReservation: Following on foot by car is conspicuously excessive and assumes a street accessible to vehicles. A's offer must express sincere relief at finding a way to care; B has neither requested nor accepted the escort.
records.alternativeComparison: S88-single-a escalates around an autonomy boundary and uncertain social plans. The preserved S88-single-b lets B request practical help with a charger, which A converts into sustained monitoring. Resistance versus invited assistance meaningfully distinguishes the tactics; the reference is not scored.
